summary: The current land development intelligence across seven counties highlights significant concentration and activity in Cleveland and Mecklenburg counties, with notable large-acreage parcels under watch and strong builder activity. Mecklenburg exhibits a very high-confidence locate pattern centered on Westinghouse Boulevard, correlating 16 approved residential projects with four high-watch parcels and ongoing fiber/utility construction, indicating robust infrastructure and residential growth. Cleveland county stands out with multiple large, high-watch parcels owned by LLC entities signaling targeted landholding possibly for future development. Union county reveals active residential and economic development projects with multiple zoning changes and incentive grants on the agenda, suggesting accelerating growth. Telecom infrastructure opportunities are prominent in Mecklenburg with strong utility construction signals, followed by Cabarrus’s moderate telecom expansion and general utility activity in Union. Continuous GIS monitoring of high watch-score parcels and builder activity in these counties will be crucial to anticipate construction phase readiness and infrastructure demands.
key_findings: Cleveland county has several large parcels (317 - 546 acres) with top watch scores of 9, owned mostly by LLCs, indicating potential future development or land banking.
Mecklenburg county shows a very high-confidence development cluster on Westinghouse Boulevard with 16 approved residential projects near high-watch parcels.
Union county is actively progressing multiple residential development rezonings and economic incentive approvals, highlighting growth momentum and infrastructure impact.

Builder activity is concentrated mainly in Gaston, Mecklenburg, and Union counties, with multiple selling and coming soon single-family communities by Eastwood Homes, D.R. Horton, and Taylor Morrison.
Locate patterns and telecom signals point to fiber and utility infrastructure expansion in Mecklenburg and Cabarrus counties, aligning with residential and commercial growth corridors.
top_opportunities: Leverage Mecklenburg’s Westinghouse Boulevard cluster for targeted telecom infrastructure rollout to service expanding residential developments.
Monitor Cleveland’s top watch-score parcels for emerging development plans or land use changes, providing early engagement opportunities for land acquisition or infrastructure deployment.
Capitalize on Union’s active zoning and economic development initiatives to influence infrastructure planning and secure early builder partnerships.
Explore the moderate telecom expansion signals near Concord Mills Boulevard in Cabarrus as potential sites for fiber buildout supporting commercial growth.
Engage builders active in Gaston and Mecklenburg to align infrastructure services with current and upcoming home communities.
telecom_insights: Mecklenburg’s locate pattern on Westinghouse Boulevard signals intense fiber and utility construction near multiple residential projects and high-watch land parcels.
Cabarrus presents directional bore or utility work indicative of telecom expansion in a commercial growth zone around Concord Mills Boulevard.
Union county shows a general utility construction signal near South Rocky River Road but lacks proximate projects or watch parcels, reflecting lower immediate telecom infrastructure demand.
The fiber/utility signals in Mecklenburg correlate with larger land parcels under watch, suggesting pre-development infrastructure staging.
Telecom infrastructure deployment should prioritize Mecklenburg and Cabarrus corridors to align with both residential builder momentum and commercial land use.
counties_to_watch: Cleveland - for large, high-priority land parcels owned by development LLCs signifying future project initiation.
Mecklenburg - for high-density residential and infrastructure clusters especially around Westinghouse Boulevard.
Union - for active residential zoning changes and economic development incentives impacting land demand and infrastructure requirements.
Cabarrus - for emerging telecom expansion signals and commercial land activity around Concord Mills Boulevard.
Gaston - for builder activity and community sales indicating steady residential development.
recommended_actions: Initiate targeted engagement with land owners holding Cleveland’s high watch-score parcels to assess development intent and infrastructure needs.
Coordinate telecom infrastructure planning with Mecklenburg residential projects along Westinghouse Boulevard to optimize fiber rollout ahead of construction peaks.
Track Union’s legislative agenda and economic incentives closely to time infrastructure investments with zoning and development approvals.
Investigate Cabarrus’s telecom locate signals for early fiber deployment and potential partnership with commercial property owners, e.g., Charlotte Motor Speedway LLC.
Maintain updated GIS monitoring of builder communities and high watch-score parcels for dynamic response to shifting development landscapes.
